notes.title: New Anomaly Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Long time, no see!

We're happy to announce that [b]Bleeding Leprechaun Studios[/b] (The guys that have helped us with some of the maps) has joined us at Firelight Innovations to help with Anomaly and any future projects! 

We've been spending these last few months reorganizing the company and evaluating our options. Thus, we have decided to start from scratch with Anomaly. We do plan on bringing over some of our code base and assets, but most will be trashed. We will be working on a completely new design with better game mechanics. More thought and effort will be put into the maps and significant effort to increase their quality. We still plan on introducing VR and multiplayer. We will be enhancing the current modding system with a dedicated platform called Fire Engine, which we will develop in-house. This will allow modders to more easily create custom mods and maps for Anomaly and any future game we release. 

We will be releasing a road map & screenshots as we progress further through this process, so stay tuned!

notes.title: We're resuming development
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It's summertime in Texas now and the development team is no longer clogged up with schoolwork. We can finally end our hiatus and come back to working on the game. We have some significant changes planned to make Anomaly better and more fun. This includes: 

[list]
[*] New jumpscare system
[*] Reworked Anomaly that is more random, dynamic, and vocal
[*] New volumetric and simulated 3D audio engine 
[*] Longer, better, and more feature-rich maps 
[*] Balances to player movement and the LiDar scanner
[*] Multiplayer
[*] VR Support
[*] Keybinds & accessibility menu
[*] Localizations 
[*] And many more!
[/list]

It will take us some time to get this added, but we will continue through this quarter to get more added. We also have some news that we will be announcing regarding the company and some major changes we are making.

notes.title: Update Plans
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

We've had a very smooth and successful launch of Anomaly. We will keep a close eye on the game and everything to ensure things keep going smoothly. We will release a minor bug fixing and polish patch in the next few days. 

For more major plans, we plan on starting work on a major update, the [b]AI & Jumpscare Update[/b]. We plan on adding new jumpscares if you die. They will only happen some of the time so you won't know when they will happen. We'll also be adding an end-game report to see how long it took and other stats about your session. We potentially might add a leaderboard for each official map in the game so everyone can see who completed it the fastest. For the AI part, we plan on making the behavior of the Anomaly much more complex. He will be teasing you with fake anomalies that you'll be seeing around the map. He will also have a delayed spawn, making it easier to get a bearing on the map and where you are at. We will also be doing some changes to the Anomaly to make it ready for [b]Multiplayer[/b] in a later update.

notes.title: We're releasing in 3 days!
notes.content: Anomaly will be coming out on Friday, February 3, 2023! We've had some more time due to some events that have happened to get the game wrapped up and ready to ship. We will spend the next few days fixing any bugs or issues with the game so expect some updates after launch. We plan on developing new maps and gameplay features in the next few months. We will add more information on these when the time comes.

notes.title: We're releasing onto steam soon!
notes.content: We are happy to announce that we will be releasing Anomaly onto steam on February 3, 2023! We're taking this as a big learning experience for us here at Firelight Studios so if anything goes wrong now is the time to fix it. We will be releasing 2 official developer-made maps and a tool to allow users to create their own maps. We hope that the game picks up some steam after release and if it does we will be updating the game by adding new maps and maybe even multiplayer. Can't wait to how things go after release!
